ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and document monitoring platform designed for industrial land compliance, cross-referencing GIS data with municipal regulatory documents to automate safety and zoning audits.
ideas.title: VibrantCompliance-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of GeoNex-ATLAS by tackling industrial land compliance through satellite monitoring, addressing the strong evaluation criteria of practical real-world challenge solving expected at G.L. Bajaj Institute events.

ideas.pitch: A graph intelligence platform combined with LightGBM to detect anomalous transaction patterns and multi-user collusion in campus financial portals and fee gateways.
ideas.title: SmartCampus AML & Fraud Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes genuinely hard engineering by combining graph intelligence and explainable ML, mimicking the high-technical-bar approach of the Bito AML detection system.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven campus nutrition and wellness assistant that scans hostel or mess menus, predicts nutritional intake, and delivers personalized dietary guidance for student athletes.
ideas.title: NutriCampus AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds on the proven success of the E-Foodiee platform by focusing on practical, localized lifestyle guidance that directly resonates with a college student demographic.

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and GAM-powered predictive forecasting tool for university server infrastructure to predict system bottlenecks, downtime incidents, and security breaches with 90% prediction intervals.
ideas.title: AI Incident Forecaster for Campus IT
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies rigorous statistical modeling and regression techniques seen in the AI Incident Forecasting winning project, demonstrating advanced problem-solving skills to judges.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student grievance and sustainability query resolution platform powered by LangGraph and localized RAG pipelines to assist campus administrative workflows.
ideas.title: EcoCampus Multi-Agent Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the multi-agent student support architecture that won the GreenNovation Hackathon, providing immediate operational utility for university organizers.
